integrity: The proof gives an unconditional asymptotic bound using classical prime-harmonic estimates. No independent validation or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Does not settle infinitude or exact counting asymptotics of equality solutions.
Historical priority of the quantitative upper bound has not been independently established.
Computation to 500000 is corroboration, not a proof of the unbounded claim.
title: Stretched-exponential sparsity of unitary–exponential divisor-sum coincidences
